# Collapsible

One region that opens under its trigger: show more, advanced settings, the log behind an error. No chrome of its own, a height tween on the system's motion tokens, and a mark that turns rather than swaps.

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)

<Collapsible open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
    <h4>Attachments 5</h4>
    <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" swapKey={open ? "less" : "more"} className="-mr-2.5">
        {open ? "Show less" : "Show 3 more"}
        <CollapsibleIcon />
      </Button>
    </CollapsibleTrigger>
  </div>
  <ul>{/* the first two files */}</ul>
  <CollapsibleContent>
    <ul>{/* the other three */}</ul>
  </CollapsibleContent>
</Collapsible>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add collapsible
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/collapsible/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleTrigger,
  CollapsibleIcon,
  CollapsibleContent,
} from "@/components/ui/collapsible"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Collapsible>
      <CollapsibleTrigger>
        Advanced settings
        <CollapsibleIcon />
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent>…</CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  )
}
```

## The trigger

On its own, `CollapsibleTrigger` is a quiet text control with the mark beside it, and its target grows to 40px without growing the text. With `asChild` it hands its behavior to your own control and keeps none of its look, which is how the Button above works: the Button stays a Button, and its label rolls while the caret turns.

```tsx
<Collapsible>
  <p>Koala ships every component as source you own…</p>
  <CollapsibleContent>
    <p>Updates keep your edits…</p>
  </CollapsibleContent>
  <CollapsibleTrigger className="mt-3">
    Read more
    <CollapsibleIcon />
  </CollapsibleTrigger>
</Collapsible>
```

## Markers

`CollapsibleIcon` turns with the trigger it sits in, on the same `caret-turn` beat as the height, so the mark and the region move as one gesture. `marker` picks the glyph and its turn: `caret` (the default) flips 180° for a panel below, `branch` turns 90° into a nested list, and `plus` turns 45° into a cross, the same mark Accordion and FAQ rows use.

```tsx
<CollapsibleTrigger>Caret <CollapsibleIcon /></CollapsibleTrigger>
<CollapsibleTrigger><CollapsibleIcon marker="branch" /> Branch</CollapsibleTrigger>
<CollapsibleTrigger>Plus <CollapsibleIcon marker="plus" /></CollapsibleTrigger>
```

## Advanced settings

The fields most people never touch, folded under the ones everyone fills in. Layout goes on `CollapsibleContent`'s `className`: it styles the body, never the wrapper whose height is tweening, so the motion stays smooth.

```tsx
<Collapsible>
  <CollapsibleTrigger>
    <Gear weight="bold" className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
    Advanced settings
    <CollapsibleIcon />
  </CollapsibleTrigger>
  <CollapsibleContent className="flex flex-col gap-4 pt-4">
    <Field>
      <FieldLabel>Build command</FieldLabel>
      <InputRoot><InputField defaultValue="npm run build" /></InputRoot>
      <FieldHint>Runs before every deploy.</FieldHint>
    </Field>
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
      <Label htmlFor="preview-deploys">Preview deploys for every branch</Label>
      <Switch id="preview-deploys" defaultChecked />
    </div>
  </CollapsibleContent>
</Collapsible>
```

## Detail on demand

Collapsible paints nothing, so it drops inside other components without a second frame. Here an Alert says what happened, and the log that says why stays folded until someone asks for it.

```tsx
<Alert variant="destructive">
  <AlertIcon />
  <AlertContent>
    <AlertTitle>Build failed</AlertTitle>
    <AlertDescription>The deploy stopped at the type check. Nothing went live.</AlertDescription>
    <Collapsible>
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="mt-2">
        Show build log
        <CollapsibleIcon />
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent className="pt-3">
        <CodeSnippet lang="bash" code={buildLog} />
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  </AlertContent>
</Alert>
```

## Motion

The region's height tweens on the collapsible keyframes, retimed to `duration-base` and `ease-out`, and its body fades in with a 4px drop on the same clock, then out with a plain fade, softer than the way in. Content that renders open is never animated on page load: Radix skips the height, and the root holds the fade back until the state has changed once.

## API reference

### Collapsible

A plain `<div>` with no chrome. Props: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `disabled`, `asChild`, `className`.

### CollapsibleTrigger

A `<button>` carrying `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `data-state`. Styled as a text control unless `asChild` is set, in which case your element keeps its own look.

### CollapsibleIcon

The disclosure mark, decorative. Props: `marker` (`caret` · `branch` · `plus`), `className`, and any SVG attribute. It turns on the state of the trigger it sits in.

### CollapsibleContent

The region, unmounted while closed. Takes every `<div>` prop; `className` styles the body inside the animated wrapper.

## FAQ

### Collapsible or Accordion?

Collapsible for one region that opens on its own. Accordion for a set of rows that share rules, such as only one open at a time, and that should look like a list.

### Where do I put padding and gaps?

On `CollapsibleContent` through `className`: it styles the body, not the wrapper whose height animates. Padding on the animated wrapper would jump at the start and end of the tween.

### Can the trigger open on hover?

No. A region that opens and closes under a moving pointer reads as accidental and does nothing on touch or keyboard. It opens on click, Space and Enter.

### Why doesn't my mark turn?

`CollapsibleIcon` turns on the state of the trigger around it, so it has to be inside `CollapsibleTrigger`, or inside the element you passed to it with `asChild`.

### Is the hidden content still in the page?

No. A closed region is removed once its exit animation ends, so it leaves the tab order and the accessibility tree. Fields inside it unmount with it: if the region can close before the form is sent, keep their values in state or in your form library rather than only in the inputs.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add collapsible` writes `components/ui/collapsible/`. Import from `@/components/ui/collapsible`:

- Components and helpers: `Collapsible`, `CollapsibleTrigger`, `CollapsibleIcon`, `CollapsibleContent`, `collapsibleVariants`
- Types: `CollapsibleProps`, `CollapsibleIconProps`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `create-context`, `hit-area`, `tv`, `utils`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`, `radix-ui`
